integration_decision.name: CRASH_ORPHAN_RECOVERY_IS_VALID_ARCHIVE_ONLY
integration_decision.finding: The integrated orphan-lock cleanup/replay contract assumes the archive remains well-formed. Pinned storage.append_observations writes each JSONL row and newline before final flush/fsync, so a process crash during a row can leave a truncated tail; _load_observations_unlocked raises ValueError for malformed JSONL after the orphan is removed. Existing test_archive_reader_writer_visibility pauses a partial row but resumes and completes it; test_archive_orphan_lock_fail_closed crashes with a held lock but does not write a partial row. Neither proves crash-corrupt-tail recovery. This is a source-derived failure mode, not an observed production incident.
integration_decision.decision: Keep previously frozen intact-archive orphan recovery contract; explicitly qualify its PASS as recovery after lock cleanup with VALID JSONL. Do not infer corrupt-tail auto-repair, do not silently delete or truncate archive rows. Treat partial-tail crash as separate fail-closed integrity risk and do not expand Gemini queue while diagnostics and exact-SHA execution remain blocked.
integration_decision.runnable_no_network_negative_control: In isolated tmp_path seed valid baseline archive + three persisted handoffs; record exact bytes/hashes. Spawn lock-owning child with positive acquired ACK, append and fsync only a deliberately incomplete JSONL row, ACK partial bytes, os._exit(17). Parent verifies child exit=17 and lock inode. Before cleanup require lock timeout and unchanged three handoff hashes. Remove only positively identified test-owned orphan after child death; load_observations must raise ValueError identifying the malformed line, and archive bytes plus published handoffs must remain unchanged (no silent truncation/repair). This is a negative integrity oracle; valid-archive postcleanup append/read/handoff recovery remains a separate positive test. Do not assert current implementation can automatically repair corrupt tails.
integration_decision.proof_boundary: Source inspection only; test NOT RUN; no production defect reproduction or promotion validation.
